title: Diocletian is proclaimed Roman emperor
summary: The army acclaimed Diocletian emperor near Nicomedia after the death of Emperor Numerian. He personally killed the prefect Aper, accused of Numerian's murder.
reason: The Roman Empire was deep in the Crisis of the Third Century, with emperors rapidly made and killed by the army.
significance: His reforms, including the Tetrarchy, ended the crisis and reshaped the late Roman state.
